name: manual_f4b012
claim: xAI Grok Build (Elon Musk) installs a bare agent CLI at ~/.grok/bin/agent — it is NOT Cursor. PATH collision: scripts invoking agent without a path hit Grok TUI instead of cursor-agent. Always call cursor-agent explicitly and document both binaries in harness skills.

decisions.notes: PR #108 cursor-agent skill; operators with both Grok and Cursor installed saw wrong tool invoked when docs said agent

rationale: PR #108 cursor-agent skill; operators with both Grok and Cursor installed saw wrong tool invoked when docs said agent
